faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) under the Centre for Industrial Consultancy and Sponsored Research for project-based positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Research Scientist I, which is being recruited for the Applied Mechanics and Biomedical Engineering department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Research Scientist I position under the current notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 06 November 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist I?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of INR 56,000 along with 30% HRA as per the project norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a First Class Post Graduate Degree including integrated PG Degree, or a Second Class post Graduate Degree including integrated PG degree with a PhD.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is up to 35 years, calculated as on the closing date for the submission of the online application.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or required in the official notification for submitting the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a test or interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through the online application portal provided on the official IIT Madras careers website before the closing date.
